newsitem.title: USA: Top 10 movies at the U.S. box office.
newsitem.headline: Top 10 movies at the U.S. box office.

text.p: Following are ticket sales for the top movies at the U.S. box office over the Friday to Sunday weekend, according to estimates by Exhibitor Relations Co. Final data will be released on Monday.
NOTE: Figures in parentheses are last week's rank.
"Liar Liar" and "That Old Feeling" are released by Universal Pictures, a unit of Seagram Co. Ltd..
"The Saint" is released by Paramount Pictures, a unit of Viacom Inc..
"The Devil's Own" and "Double Team" are released by Sony Corp..
"Jungle 2 Jungle" and "The 6th Man" are released by Walt Disney Co.
"Selena" is released by Warner Bros., a unit of Time Warner Inc..
"Return of the Jedi" and "Inventing the Abbotts" are released by 20th Century Fox, a unit of News Corp..
